item.title: Nancy Guthrie case takes new turn as sheriff identifies key January date
item.description: Sheriff Chris Nanos has confirmed that investigators are looking into significant activity that occurred at Nancy Guthrie's home on January 11, weeks before she disappeared

item.title: Tiger Woods will only add to Masters uncertainty after TGL bombshell
item.description: Tiger Woods will play his first TGL match in more than a year on Tuesday, but his return leaves the big question unanswered — can he walk Augusta National for four days at the Masters next month?

item.title: McDonald's super fan who's eaten 36,000 Big Macs doesn't like new burger
item.description: Donald Gorske, who has eaten a Big Mac daily for over 54 years and holds the Guinness World Record for most Big Macs consumed, shares his honest review of McDonald's new Big Arch burger.

item.title: Stephen Miller 'losing patience' with Trump as he's caught 'showing anger'
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Stephen Miller's 'irritation built up' as Donald Trump harped on about the war in Iran, with one body language expert saying he was 'angry' during POTUS's speech

item.title: Melania Trump critics joke 'don't quit your day job' after awkward summit speech
item.description: Donald Trump's wife delivered brief remarks at the Fostering the Future Summit on Tuesday, March 24, and viewers were quick to mock and compare her speech to a Beach Boys song

item.title: Kim Jong-Un's daughter and successor, 14, shows off gun skills in new photo
item.description: Kim Jong-Un's daughter has been pictured firing a pistol, weeks after photos showed her shooting a rifle, giving rise to rumors that she is being promoted as heir to the North Korea leader.

item.title: March Madness coach launches rant over 'unfair' treatment as UConn point made
item.description: Syracuse women's basketball coach Felisha Legette-Jack spoke out against the NCAA Tournament bracket format after her team's 53-point loss to UConn marked the fifth elimination by the school in seven years

item.title: March Madness coach turns air red with furious outburst at officials
item.description: Florida's March Madness title defense ended with a dramatic 73-72 loss to Iowa after coach Todd Golden's expletive-filled outburst over a technical foul call, before Alvaro Folgueiras hit the game-winner with under five seconds left

item.title: 'So hard' - Niele Ivey speaks after 'emotional' Notre Dame win at March Madness
item.description: Niele Ivey led Notre Dame to its fifth consecutive March Madness Sweet 16 appearance with Monday's upset win against 3-seed Ohio State, leading to an outpouring of emotion from the Irish head coach

item.title: St. John hero's NFL connection comes to light after March Madness heroics
item.description: Dylan Darling, who hit the game-winning basket for St. John's against Kansas in the NCAA Tournament with 3.9 seconds left, is the son of former New York Jets linebacker James Darling
